newsitem.title: USA: Capital Re to buy a Lloyd's managing firm.
newsitem.headline: Capital Re to buy a Lloyd's managing firm.

text.p: Capital Re Corp said on Monday that it has signed a memorandum of understanding to acquire Tower Street Holdings Ltd, the parent company of a Lloyd's managing agency that manages three syndicates.

Tower Street is the parent of RGB Underwriting Agencies Ltd, the manager of non-marine syndicate 490 and two life syndicates 1171 and 332, with capacity of over 100 million British pounds, Capital Re said.
Capital Re said the participation in RGB and its syndicates will provide it access to the principal international market for specialty insurance and reinsurance products.
Entry into the Lloyd's market is pending the completion of the reconstruction of Lloyd's and the acquisition of Tower Street, Capital Re said.
Capital Re said the move into the Lloyd's market is to continue earnings growth and target a return on equity in the mid-teens.
